origin: daW³ regression cases (songs users imported from strudel.cc)

tunes.name: slider-widgets
tunes.code:
setcpm(120/4)

$: s("bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8").bank("RolandTR909")
  .gain(slider(0.8, 0, 1))

$: n("<0 3 5 7>*4").scale("C:minor").s("sawtooth")
  .lpf(slider(1200, 200, 5000, 1))
  .lpq(slider(8, 0, 20))
  .room(slider(0.3))
  ._pianoroll()

_$: note("c2 eb2").s("supersaw")

tunes.name: samples-and-await
tunes.code:
await samples('github:tidalcycles/dirt-samples')
samples({ kit: ['bd/BT0A0A7.wav', 'sd/rytm-01-classic.wav'] }, 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tidalcycles/Dirt-Samples/master/')
const pat = "<0 2 [4 6]>"
let chords = chord("<Am7 Dm7 G7 C^7>").voicing()

drums: s("kit:0 kit:1").fast(2)
keys: chords.s("piano").room(.5)
mel: n(pat).scale("A:minor").s("triangle").delay(.25)
all(x => x.gain(.9))
